unit_configs.cmd:
PD=/tmp/pd_single;mkdir -p $PD
cp /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/proxy.sh /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/prefill.sh /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/decode.sh $PD/
printf '%s\n' 'import os' 'i=os.environ.get("POD_IP","")' 'r=os.environ.get("PD_ROLE","p")' 'print(i+";"+("127.0.0.1" if r=="c" else i))' > $PD/get_node_ip_list.py
sed -i 's/temp+=(\$i)/temp+=($((i+4)))/' $PD/decode.sh
sed -i 's/devices=$(seq -s, \$start \$((end - 1)))/devices=$(seq -s, $((start+4)) $((end-1+4)))/' $PD/decode.sh
sed -i 's/--host "\${cur_pod_ip}"/--host 127.0.0.1/' $PD/decode.sh
grep -q 'i+4' $PD/decode.sh&&grep -q 'start+4' $PD/decode.sh|| exit 1
export npu=4
M='{"image":{"rgba_background_color":[128,128,128]},"video":{"num_frames":32,"sample_fps":1}}'
if [ -f ${MODEL_PATH}/preprocessor_config.json ];then M=$(python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('${MODEL_PATH}/preprocessor_config.json'));print(json.dumps({'image':{'rgba_background_color':[128,128,128]},'video':{'num_frames':d.get('num_frames',32),'sample_fps':d.get('sample_fps',1)}},separators=(',',':')))");fi
C="--max-model-len 262144 --block-size 128 --additional-config {\"enable_low_latency\":true,\"npugraph_ex_config\":{\"enable\":true,\"super_kernel_optimize\":false,\"static_kernel_compile\":true}} --speculative_config {\"method\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":3} --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager --enable-expert-parallel --no-enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill --dtype bfloat16 --hf-overrides {\"model_architectures\":\"OpenPanguV2ForCausalLM\",\"text_config\":{\"model_architectures\":\"OpenPanguV2ForCausalLM\"}} --allowed-local-media-path / --mm-processor-kwargs {\"image_use_fast\":true}"
echo '{"connector_type":"NetworkMMFeatureConnector","remote_endpoints":["tcp://'${POD_IP}':5555"],"exclude_fields":""}' > /tmp/p_mm.json
PD_ROLE=c LOG_PATH=/home/ma-user/c bash $PD/proxy.sh --core-num 4 --start-core-index 16 --client-max-body-size 1000M --client-body-buffer-size 50M --subrequest-output-buffer-size 10M --omni-proxy-pd-policy sequential --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 100000 --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 16 --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 24 &
PD_ROLE=p LOG_PATH=/home/ma-user/p OMP_NUM_THREADS=32 HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV HCCL_BUFFSIZE=500 HCCL_IF_BASE_PORT=32000 TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=2 gpu_util=0.7 MASTER_PORT=8010 OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH=low_latency/openpangu_v2_vl/pangu_v2_vl_moe_w8a8c16_a2_92B_xp1d_p_open.json VLLM_OBJECT_STORAGE_SHM_BUFFER_NAME=PREFILL_SHM_BUFFER cpu_bytes_to_use=858993459200 bash $PD/prefill.sh $C --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs 16 --enforce-eager --mm-processor-cache-type shm --mm-processor-cache-gb 8 --mm-shm-cache-max-object-size-mb 256 --media-io-kwargs "$M" --mm-feature-transfer-config "$(cat /tmp/p_mm.json)" &
PD_ROLE=d LOG_PATH=/home/ma-user/d OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AI_CPU HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1000 HCCL_IF_BASE_PORT=33000 TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1 gpu_util=0.8 MASTER_PORT=8000 LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE=4 OMNI_LMHEAD_USE_DEVICE_COMM_A2A=1 VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/start_server/graph_cache VLLM_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 ENABLE_DP_LB=false VLLM_DATA_PARALLEL_EXTERNAL_LB=false OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH=low_latency/openpangu_v2_vl/pangu_v2_vl_moe_w8a8c16_a2_92B_xp1d_d_open.json VLLM_OBJECT_STORAGE_SHM_BUFFER_NAME=DECODE_SHM_BUFFER cpu_bytes_to_use=53687091200 bash $PD/decode.sh $C --max-num-seqs 24 --max-num-batched-tokens 96 --distributed-executor-backend mp --mm-processor-cache-gb 8 --compilation-config '{"mode":3,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[4,64,96],"backend":"","compile_sizes":[4,64,96]}' --media-io-kwargs "$M" --mm-feature-transfer-config '{"connectors":{"local":{"connector_type":"DiskMMFeatureConnector"},"remote":{"connector_type":"NetworkMMFeatureConnector","is_producer":false,"local_endpoint":"tcp://0.0.0.0:5555"}}}' &
wait
unit_configs.name: pd
